_why: Written 2026-08-08. Wingmate is pre-launch ('Coming to iOS'), so this contract exists to hold its one absolute claim to the code BEFORE the listing goes live rather than after. Verified against /Users/dee/Developer/DrVanus/Wingmate.

evidence: There is no sign-in surface: a grep of Wingmate for ASAuthorization, SignInWithApple, GIDSignIn and signIn( returns nothing, and no password, profile or registration screen exists.

Identity to the backend is a locally minted random id, not a personal one: Wingmate/App/SpeechManager.swift:156 reads WingmateDeviceIdentity.deviceId and passes it at :166 and :250. That is the same pattern Rowan and Alder use, and it is what makes support.html's 'There is no account and no sign-in. Nothing to reset, and no password to lose' true.

contract_notes: Pre-launch. Re-run tools/audit_sites.py wingmate at launch and delete the 'coming to iOS' line from support.html and the eyebrow from index.html at the same time (status policy: status lives in one line, behaviour copy stays present-tense). A client-minted device id is an identifier, not an identity — it must never be treated as an authorization or entitlement proof.
